incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> oncall@redwood (High p99 latency for inference-service-prod) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-1847 created and notified escalation policy 'inference-oncall'
Alex Chen: seeing the alert ping, looking into dashboards now. p95 okay, p99 jumped to ~2.1s in the last 5m
Mira Gomez: confirmed from traces — tail latency concentrated on model-worker-3 and model-worker-7 in us-west-2
Samir Patel: any deploys in the last 30m? I don't see a CI deploy, but autoscaler did scale out a node group 18m ago
Tia Reynolds: tagging: customer-impact?
Alex Chen: some customers saw increased latency on streaming endpoints; error rates are stable, so avgs fine but tail is heavy. likely KV cache cold or hotspot
Platform SRE Bot: hint: check KV-cache hit ratio: `curl -s http://metrics.svc/cache/hits | jq .`
Mira Gomez: running quick query on backend metrics: `sum(rate(kv_cache_misses[5m])) by (pod)` -> model-worker-3 shows 3x misses vs peers
Samir Patel: I'm going to temporarily reduce max batch size on model-worker-3 to force smaller batches and lower latency. Applying patch to runtime config now
Alex Chen: good idea. also enable prefix KV priming for the hottest keys on that worker: `POST /admin/prime?k=...`
Tia Reynolds: PagerDuty acking now -> @pagerduty acknowledge by Samir Patel :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Acknowledged by Samir Patel. Notification silenced for 30m
Mira Gomez: config applied on worker-3: `max_batch=8` -> rolling restart of process 3/3, waiting for warmup
Alex Chen: after restart, p99 dropped to 1.1s for that pod, overall service p99 down to ~1.4s, still above SLO (1.0s) but trending better
Tia Reynolds: any customer-facing actions we should trigger? status page?
Samir Patel: hold on status page update. I'll keep oncall updated in 10m. If we hit <1.0s for 5m continuous, we can close the PD incident
incident-bot: Note: automatic fallback route (model-variant-fallback) is enabled for 50% of traffic due to latency SLO policy
Alex Chen: enabling fallback started at 2437654380, roughly 60s ago. It's routing requests to a slightly lower-capacity quantized variant with lower tail latencies
Mira Gomez: quantized variant has lower p99 but slightly different output; QA on eval set looks acceptable for now. No customer complaints reported yet
Tia Reynolds: Samir, want to hand this to next oncall in 15m? I'm on rotation for the next shift starting in 20m and can take it over if it's still active
Samir Patel: yes please, planning a handoff. I'll summarize mitigations in the incident thread: reduced batch size on worker-3, primed KV cache, enabled fallback routing. ETA for complete rollback of autoscaler change is 45m if needed
Alex Chen: adding a temporary sampling of traces to capture any remaining tail patterns: `trace.sample=0.5` for high-latency requests
Platform SRE Bot: Alert suppression set for 10 minutes to avoid alert thrash while we monitor
Mira Gomez: p99 at 0.95s over last 3m — under SLO now. Starting 5m watch period
Samir Patel: handing off to Tia in 10m with runbook notes. If it regresses, escalate to L2 and consider draining model-worker-7 and reprovisioning
Tia Reynolds: got it. I'll take the incident at 2437654980 if still active. Preparing brief for next shift: steps + CI links + traceback query
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-1847 status: acknowledged -> monitoring -> assigned to oncall.
Alex Chen: quick note for postmortem: investigate autoscaler scale-out interaction with KV cache warming. Might need priming during scale events or a slow ramp policy
Mira Gomez: also correlate request distribution by user-id hashes to check for hot keys causing cache thrash
Samir Patel: closing PD if stable for 10m. Will update the thread. Thanks all :pray:
incident-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents and linked to internal ticket RED-4291 for follow-up
Tia Reynolds: handoff complete. leaving watch to next oncall. If anything flares, tag me @Tia Reynolds and I'll jump in. :v:
